Preview.intro: A warm, restrained visual system created for a modern private dental clinic — balancing clinical clarity with a more personal sense of care.

Preview.rhythmBody: Fine rules, generous space and careful hierarchy replace excessive cards, shadows and decorative medical graphics.
Preview.principleOneBody: Ivory surfaces, soft contrast and room for content to breathe.
Preview.principleTwoBody: One dominant booking action supported by quiet secondary links.
Preview.principleThreeBody: English and Arabic receive equal hierarchy, spacing and visual care.

general-dentistry.title: General Dentistry
general-dentistry.shortDescription: Routine care focused on maintaining the health, comfort and function of your teeth.
general-dentistry.intro: General dentistry forms the foundation of long-term oral health — covering the routine check-ups, preventive care and minor treatments that keep your teeth and gums healthy.
general-dentistry.whatIs: General dentistry includes examinations, professional cleaning, fillings, and preventive advice. It focuses on early detection and maintaining your natural teeth in good condition.
general-dentistry.whoBenefits: General dentistry is suitable for patients of all ages. Whether you are due for a routine check-up, have a specific concern, or want to maintain your oral health, general dental care is the right starting point.
general-dentistry.whatToExpect: A typical visit includes a thorough examination, any necessary X-rays, a professional clean, and a discussion of your oral health. Your dentist will explain any findings and recommend next steps clearly.
general-dentistry.comfort: Check-ups and routine treatments are generally comfortable. Your dentist will take time to explain each step and check in on your comfort throughout the visit.
processSteps: Examination and assessment of your oral health

cosmetic-dentistry.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
cosmetic-dentistry.shortDescription: Personalised options designed to refine the appearance of your smile with a natural result in mind.
cosmetic-dentistry.intro: Cosmetic dentistry focuses on enhancing the appearance of your smile through a range of considered treatments, always with a natural and harmonious result in mind.
cosmetic-dentistry.whatIs: Cosmetic dentistry includes treatments such as veneers, bonding, and smile redesign. Each option is tailored to your features and preferences, aiming for a result that looks and feels natural.
cosmetic-dentistry.whoBenefits: Cosmetic dentistry may suit patients who wish to refine the shape, colour, or alignment of their teeth. A consultation will help determine which options are appropriate for your individual case.
cosmetic-dentistry.whatToExpect: Your journey begins with a consultation to understand your goals. Your dentist will assess your teeth, discuss options, and create a personalised plan before any treatment begins.
cosmetic-dentistry.comfort: Many cosmetic treatments are minimally invasive. Your dentist will explain what to expect and ensure you are comfortable throughout the process.
processSteps: Review and guidance for maintaining results

dental-implants.title: Dental Implants
dental-implants.shortDescription: A structured consultation-led approach to replacing missing teeth and restoring confidence.
dental-implants.intro: Dental implants offer a structured approach to replacing missing teeth, designed to restore both function and confidence through a carefully planned process.
dental-implants.whatIs: A dental implant is a small post placed in the jaw to support a replacement tooth. It is designed to provide a stable, long-lasting solution for one or more missing teeth.
dental-implants.whoBenefits: Implants may be suitable for patients who have lost one or more teeth and have adequate jawbone support. A thorough assessment is needed to determine if implants are the right option for you.
dental-implants.whatToExpect: The implant process is planned across multiple stages — from initial consultation and assessment to placement and the fitting of the final restoration. Your dentist will guide you through each step.
dental-implants.comfort: Implant procedures are typically performed with appropriate care for your comfort. Your dentist will explain the process and aftercare in detail before treatment begins.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.shortDescription: Treatments designed to align teeth and improve bite function for long-term oral health.
orthodontics.intro: Orthodontics focuses on aligning teeth and correcting bite issues, contributing to both the appearance and long-term function of your smile.
orthodontics.whatIs: Orthodontic treatment uses appliances such as braces or clear aligners to gradually move teeth into better alignment. The approach is tailored to your individual needs and dental development.
orthodontics.whoBenefits: Orthodontics may benefit patients with crowded, spaced, or misaligned teeth, or those with bite issues. A consultation will help determine the most appropriate approach for your case.
orthodontics.whatToExpect: Treatment begins with an assessment of your teeth and bite. Your dentist will discuss your options, expected timeline, and what each stage of treatment involves.
orthodontics.comfort: Modern orthodontic approaches are designed with comfort in mind. You may experience some adjustment periods, which your dentist will help you manage.
processSteps: Assessment of teeth and bite alignment

teeth-whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
teeth-whitening.shortDescription: A gentle approach to brightening your smile with professional supervision.
teeth-whitening.intro: Professional teeth whitening offers a supervised way to brighten your smile, using methods designed for safety and a natural-looking result.
teeth-whitening.whatIs: Teeth whitening is a cosmetic treatment that lightens the shade of your teeth. Professional whitening is supervised by your dentist to ensure safe and even results.
teeth-whitening.whoBenefits: Whitening may suit patients who want to brighten their smile and have healthy teeth and gums. A consultation will confirm whether whitening is appropriate for you.
teeth-whitening.whatToExpect: After an assessment, your dentist will recommend a whitening approach suited to your teeth. Treatment may be performed in-office or with a take-home kit, depending on the recommended plan.
teeth-whitening.comfort: Professional whitening is designed to minimise sensitivity. Your dentist will discuss what to expect and how to care for your teeth during and after treatment.
processSteps: Assessment of tooth shade and suitability

root-canal-treatment.title: Root Canal Treatment
root-canal-treatment.shortDescription: A treatment designed to preserve a damaged tooth and relieve discomfort.
root-canal-treatment.intro: Root canal treatment is a procedure that aims to save a tooth that has been damaged by decay or infection, relieving discomfort and preserving your natural tooth where possible.
root-canal-treatment.whatIs: Root canal treatment involves removing the damaged tissue inside a tooth, cleaning the area, and sealing it to prevent further infection. The goal is to preserve the natural tooth structure.
root-canal-treatment.whoBenefits: Root canal treatment may be recommended for patients with deep decay, infection, or damage to a tooth's inner tissue. An examination is needed to determine if this treatment is appropriate.
root-canal-treatment.whatToExpect: Your dentist will assess the tooth, explain the need for treatment, and carry out the procedure over one or more visits. A restoration is usually placed afterwards to protect the tooth.
root-canal-treatment.comfort: Modern techniques aim to make root canal treatment as comfortable as possible. Your dentist will explain each step and ensure you are informed and at ease throughout.
processSteps: Cleaning and treating the tooth interior

pediatric-dentistry.title: Pediatric Dentistry
pediatric-dentistry.shortDescription: Gentle dental care designed for children in a calm and welcoming environment.
pediatric-dentistry.intro: Pediatric dentistry focuses on the oral health of children, providing gentle care in a calm environment that helps young patients feel comfortable and supported.
pediatric-dentistry.whatIs: Pediatric dental care includes check-ups, preventive treatments, and guidance on developing healthy oral habits. It is tailored to the needs of growing teeth and gums.
pediatric-dentistry.whoBenefits: Pediatric dentistry is designed for children from their first dental visit through their teenage years. Early and regular dental care helps establish healthy habits for life.
pediatric-dentistry.whatToExpect: A child's dental visit typically includes a gentle examination, cleaning if appropriate, and guidance for parents on caring for their child's teeth at home.
pediatric-dentistry.comfort: A calm and patient approach helps children feel at ease. The dentist will take time to explain things in a child-friendly way and proceed at a comfortable pace.

emergency-dentistry.title: Emergency Dentistry
emergency-dentistry.shortDescription: Prompt attention for urgent dental concerns and unexpected discomfort.
emergency-dentistry.intro: Emergency dental care addresses urgent concerns such as severe pain, injury, or unexpected damage — providing prompt attention when you need it most.
emergency-dentistry.whatIs: Emergency dentistry covers urgent situations including toothache, broken or knocked-out teeth, and dental injuries. The goal is to relieve discomfort and address the problem quickly.
emergency-dentistry.whoBenefits: Emergency care is for anyone experiencing a dental issue that requires immediate attention. If you are unsure whether your situation is urgent, it is best to contact the clinic for guidance.
emergency-dentistry.whatToExpect: For a dental emergency, contact the clinic as soon as possible. Your dentist will assess the situation, provide immediate care where needed, and plan any follow-up treatment.
emergency-dentistry.comfort: Emergency care prioritises relieving discomfort. Your dentist will explain what is happening and work quickly to address the issue.

metadata.title: About Us
metadata.description: Discover Bright Way Dental Clinic — a modern, calm dental practice dedicated to thoughtful, unhurried care and clear patient communication.

hero.title: Dentistry shaped by calm, clarity, and care.
hero.description: Bright Way was conceived around a single principle: dental care should feel unhurried, reassuring, and thoroughly personal from the very first moment you enter.

philosophy.title: Care that begins with listening.
philosophy.statement: We believe modern dentistry is at its best when clinical excellence is matched with genuine attentiveness.
philosophy.point1Body: Every appointment is structured with generous time to discuss your goals, answer your questions, and understand your preferences without rush.
philosophy.point2Body: We present findings with complete clarity — explaining what is recommended, why it matters, and what alternatives exist so you remain fully in control.
philosophy.point3Body: Our clinic atmosphere is designed to soften clinical apprehension, combining natural light, quiet warmth, and attentive personal care.

experience.title: A more considered approach at every step.
experience.lead: From the first inquiry to long-term preventive care, our patient experience is designed to ensure you always feel informed, respected, and at ease.
experience.body1: We recognise that many individuals carry past dental anxiety or uncertainty about procedures. That is why we place open communication at the centre of our practice — ensuring you always understand what to expect before any clinical step begins.
experience.body2: Our clinical recommendations are grounded in conservative, preventive dentistry: preserving your natural tooth structure and maintaining lasting oral wellness through thoughtful planning.
experience.pillar1Body: No confusing jargon or pressured decisions. Just straightforward explanations tailored to you.
experience.pillar2Body: Prioritising your comfort and peace of mind through careful pacing and gentle methods.
experience.pillar3Body: Supporting your smile over time with proactive preventive maintenance and trusted advice.

metadata.title: Frequently Asked Questions
metadata.description: Find clear answers to common questions regarding dental consultations, treatments, comfort, scheduling, and clinic visits at Bright Way Dental Clinic.

hero.title: Clear answers to your questions.
hero.description: We believe informed patients make the most confident decisions. Explore answers to commonly asked questions about our clinic, consultations, and treatments.

firstVisit.title: Consultations & Initial Visits
firstVisit.description: What to expect when visiting Bright Way for the first time.

whatHappens.question: What happens during my initial consultation?
whatHappens.answer: Your first visit is dedicated to understanding your oral health and personal goals. We conduct a gentle, thorough examination, review any relevant dental history, take diagnostic imaging if appropriate, and discuss our findings with you in plain language. There is never any pressure to proceed with treatment on the day.

duration.question: How long does a consultation usually take?
duration.answer: We allocate generous appointment times — typically 45 to 60 minutes — so you have plenty of time to discuss your thoughts, ask questions, and understand all available treatment paths without feeling rushed.

whatToBring.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
whatToBring.answer: Please bring a valid photo ID, details of any current medications or medical conditions, and previous dental records or X-rays if readily available. You will also have the opportunity to share your preferences and questions with our team.

appointments.title: Appointments & Booking
appointments.description: How to schedule, reschedule, and manage your visits.

howToBook.question: How can I request an appointment?
howToBook.answer: You can submit an appointment request through our online contact form, or contact the clinic directly once phone and messaging details are officially confirmed. Our team will reach out to confirm a time that suits your schedule.

rescheduling.question: What is the procedure if I need to reschedule?
rescheduling.answer: We understand schedules change. We kindly request advance notice whenever possible so we can offer that appointment time to another patient and help you find a new suitable time.

confirmation.question: How will my appointment request be confirmed?
confirmation.answer: After submitting your request, our front desk team will contact you via your preferred communication method to confirm appointment availability and provide any preparatory details.

comfort.title: Comfort & Dental Anxiety
comfort.description: How we create a calm, supportive environment for apprehensive patients.

anxiousPatients.question: I experience dental anxiety. How can Bright Way help?
anxiousPatients.answer: You are not alone; many patients feel uneasy about dental visits. We intentionally design our practice around gentle pacing, clear explanations before each step, and patient-guided pauses whenever you need a break.

painManagement.question: Will my dental treatment be painful?
painManagement.answer: Modern clinical techniques and gentle anaesthetic administration ensure that procedures are remarkably comfortable. We continually check on your comfort throughout treatment and adjust as needed.

calmingSetting.question: What makes the clinic environment different?
calmingSetting.answer: We have created a warm, serene setting that feels distinctly different from traditional sterile clinics. From natural tones to quiet treatment rooms, every detail helps put you at ease.

treatments.title: Treatments & Personalized Plans
treatments.description: Understanding how we plan and deliver your dental care.

customPlans.question: How are treatment plans created?
customPlans.answer: Following your examination, we prepare a personalized treatment plan outlining recommended steps, expected timelines, and alternative options. We review this together so you can make informed choices.

multipleVisits.question: Will I need multiple appointments for advanced treatments?
multipleVisits.answer: Certain procedures, such as dental implants, orthodontics, or complex restorative work, are structured across staged appointments to ensure optimal clinical outcomes and proper healing.

secondOpinions.question: Can I visit Bright Way for a second opinion?
secondOpinions.answer: Yes. We regularly welcome patients seeking an independent, objective clinical assessment of their dental health and treatment alternatives.

emergency.title: Emergencies & Urgent Concerns
emergency.description: Guidance on handling sudden discomfort or dental injuries.

emergencyDefinition.question: What qualifies as a dental emergency?
emergencyDefinition.answer: Severe toothache, trauma resulting in a fractured or knocked-out tooth, acute swelling, or persistent bleeding are urgent concerns that warrant immediate professional attention.

whatToDoFirst.question: What should I do immediately if a tooth is knocked out?
whatToDoFirst.answer: Hold the tooth by the crown (never the root), rinse gently with water if dirty without scrubbing, and place it in a container of cold milk or saliva. Contact emergency dental care immediately, as prompt action within the first hour greatly improves preservation.

urgentContact.question: How do I reach the clinic for urgent care?
urgentContact.answer: In urgent situations, please reach out via our direct telephone line once published. For severe facial trauma, difficulty breathing, or uncontrollable bleeding, visit the nearest hospital emergency department.

fees.title: Fees, Estimates & Insurance
fees.description: Responsible information regarding treatment costs and coverage.

costEstimates.question: How will I know the cost of my treatment?
costEstimates.answer: We provide transparent cost estimates following your clinical consultation, before any non-emergency treatment commences, ensuring you have complete clarity on fees.

insuranceAccepted.question: Do you work with insurance providers?
insuranceAccepted.answer: Insurance network participation and direct billing arrangements will be detailed once the clinic's formal provider agreements are finalized. We are always happy to provide itemized receipts for reimbursement claims.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: Read the privacy framework and data protection considerations for Bright Way Dental Clinic.

hero.title: Privacy Policy & Data Considerations
hero.draftNotice: This document represents a provisional privacy framework for the demo website. Final legal and healthcare data processing policies will be established prior to full production launch.

intro.title: 1. Commitment to Patient Privacy
intro.body: Bright Way Dental Clinic is dedicated to maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and security of all personal and medical information entrusted to us. We handle all inquiries and clinical information with the highest standard of professional care.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.body: When you interact with our website — such as when submitting an appointment request or general inquiry form — we may collect your name, email address, telephone number, preferred appointment timing, and any clinical notes you choose to provide.

usage.title: 3. How Information is Used
usage.body: Information submitted through our website is used strictly to respond to your inquiries, schedule and confirm clinical consultations, and provide relevant information regarding dental services. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Web Analytics
cookies.body: Our website may utilize essential cookies and privacy-respecting analytics to ensure proper site functionality, remember language preferences (English and Arabic), and analyze general website traffic patterns to improve user experience.

thirdParty.title: 5. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: Where third-party platforms are utilized (such as mapping services or future secure booking platforms), their handling of information is governed by their respective privacy policies in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights and Inquiries
rights.body: You have the right to request clarification regarding the information we hold about you, request corrections, or request deletion of inquiry records, subject to statutory healthcare record retention obligations.

contact.title: 7. Contact Regarding Privacy
contact.body: If you have questions regarding this privacy framework or data considerations, please reach out via our contact page. Verified clinic data protection contact details will be published upon final launch.
